basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in South Texas with a burgeoning interest in homebrewing. I work as a software developer during the day and spend my evenings experimenting with new brewing techniques. Although I'm new to Reddit, I've found it incredibly helpful for learning more about homebrewing, which has quickly become a passionate hobby of mine. I'm currently single and enjoy staying up late to catch up on Reddit threads, particularly in the homebrewing and sports gaming communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and I'm mostly self-taught when it comes to homebrewing. I started learning about it through online resources and recently joined Reddit to get tips from experienced brewers. I also have a casual interest in sports simulation games, which I explore through gaming subreddits.
